facts.fact: INE Portugal's COOPSTAT n.º 25 reports that INE-CV met Cabo Verde's National Data Protection Commission, with its Chairman Faustino Varela and a member present.
facts.system: Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados de Cabo Verde

facts.fact: INE Portugal's COOPSTAT n.º 25 says its mission supported revision of the current Law of the National Statistical System of Cabo Verde, which establishes how the system functions.

CPV.note: The document concerns revision of the statistics law and names no national statistics strategy.
